# InsightFlow GitHub Copilot Instructions

This repository uses `AGENTS.md` as the central agent guide. Read it first, then `rules.md`, `memory.md`, and the task-specific documentation before changing code or configuration.

Use source code and tests as implementation evidence. Preserve privacy, authentication, authorization, protected-branch, migration, and deployment rules. Run relevant checks, report failures honestly, and do not claim deployments or verification without provider evidence.

Do not duplicate the full governance system here. Path-specific or nested instructions may add constraints; conflicts must be reported and resolved by instruction priority.
